doc.title: Mike Vax interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2022

title: Band manager duties and finances
summary: Vax booked hotels, handled cash and bank trips, and dealt with Kenton's finances.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: What did your band manager duties entail? Were you in charge of booking motel rooms and all that kind of thing?

Yeah. Yeah I had to book all the hotels. I had to collect all the money. I had to stay in touch with Harold Plant’s office, that was the people that handled all of Stan’s finances and money and stuff. If we were getting paid in cash you had to take it — there were a couple of different banks that we used where Stan had accounts and you’d have to take it. It was really funny because sometimes we’d be out for seven or eight, nine days without getting to a bank or anything and I’d have a whole bunch of cash with me and so I thought okay the safest way is I’m going to wear old clothes and I’m going to put all the money in a paper bag and then I’m going to go to the bank. And I used to do that. And every once in a while one of the tellers would look at me like is this guy a drug dealer or what? But I thought well that’s the safest way to get to the bank. But you know and the other thing was that Stan, you always — Stan didn’t take a salary. He was amazing. All the money went to the band. The road manager was expected to have a few thousand dollars on him in case Stan needed to take people to dinner or he needed to buy some clothes or whatever. But he didn’t take an actual salary. And so yeah, I booked the hotel rooms, I did all of the financial stuff. I had to deal, when there were people who — buyers who were not being very nice I had to deal with that. Stan didn’t want to deal with that. You know and when Stan was sick that first time in 1971 and he was gone for five months, Dick Shearer and I led the band and Dick led the music and conducted and I did all of the announcing and I still do all the financial stuff. And I literally had to verbally fight with people to get the money.
